audit_definition.finite_grid: 18 rows, 219 explicit shell targets, inherited 1,380-edge grid, 17 literal cutoffs
audit_definition.primary_comparison: weighted/positive budget gap at the common weighted prefix

exact_theorem.normalization_invariance: at one common prefix, dividing both target budgets by any positive target-independent source normalizer preserves their gap
exact_theorem.prefix_threshold_monotonicity: the first feasible prefix index k_tau(b) is nonincreasing as tau increases
exact_theorem.scope: finite Euclidean target balls and positive-definite source Gram
exact_theorem.tolerance_monotonicity: tau_1<=tau_2 implies B_(k,tau_1)(b)>=B_(k,tau_2)(b) at every fixed feasible prefix
